title: Stego Phone Stand
description: A friendly stegosaurus with back plates whose body holds a phone or small tablet upright in an angled slot, with a charging-cable notch at the front.
use: Desk phone / small tablet stand for video calls and charging. Slot is 14 mm wide x 80 mm long (fits phones with slim cases).
material: PLA or PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 4 perimeters, 20% infill. No supports.
